summary: Jellyfin.Networking is a tiny 4-file assembly (NetworkManager, AutoDiscoveryHost, HappyEyeballs/HttpClientExtension, Udp/SocketFactory). The First-Light charter target is NetworkManager — the bind-address / published-server-URL selection engine — and that is portable. BUT the port surface is dominated by a hidden dependency: NetworkManager is a thin orchestrator over the `MediaBrowser.Common.Net` + `MediaBrowser.Model.Net` types (NetworkUtils, NetworkConstants, IPData, NetworkConfiguration, PublishedServerUriOverride, RemoteAccessPolicyResult, INetworkManager, ISocketFactory) which the sibling hermit-common inventory explicitly DEFERRED (its 'Net.*' deferred bullet). The parity oracle proves it: NetworkExtensionsTests and 3/4 of NetworkParseTests exercise `NetworkUtils.TryParseHost` / `TryParseToSubnet(s)` DIRECTLY, never touching NetworkManager. So the real portable payload of this crate is: (1) the pure IP/subnet math in NetworkUtils (the highest-value, most-tested unit), (2) the value types IPData / NetworkConstants / PublishedServerUriOverride / NetworkConfiguration / RemoteAccessPolicyResult, and (3) NetworkManager itself (bind selection + LAN/remote-access policy). These MUST land here since hermit-common punted them; that is an ownership decision to confirm at PORT (Net.* here vs. retro-fitting hermit-common). The ONE MediaBrowser.Controller static the charter flags — ConfigurationExtensions — supplies only the string keys `PublishedServerUrl` (AddressOverrideKey), `DetectNetworkChange` (DetectNetworkChangeKey) that NetworkManager reads from startup config; port those two consts INLINE (a `startup_config_keys` module), NOT the whole 15-key FFmpeg/kestrel/sqlite extension class. AutoDiscoveryHost, HappyEyeballs/HttpClientExtension, and SocketFactory are runtime UDP/HTTP-socket machinery with heavy runtime deps (BackgroundService/IHostedService, UdpClient, SocketsHttpConnectionContext, IServerApplicationHost, ServerDiscoveryInfo DTO) — DEFER all three per the charter's escape clause and port NetworkManager + NetworkUtils + the Net value types + the two config keys. .NET's `IPNetwork` (System.Net) has no std analogue — an external crate (`ipnet`) is required; and `IConfigurationManager.GetConfiguration<T>`/`GetNetworkConfiguration` (the trait NetworkManager pulls config through) is NOT in hermit-common yet (only ConfigurationStore/Factory/Validating landed) — port a thin `ConfigurationManager` trait or a `get_network_configuration()` hook so the mock-driven tests can inject a NetworkConfiguration.

real_cross_project_deps.note: Determined by scanning every non-System `using` across the 4 source files + the ConfigurationExtensions helper + the transitively-required Net.* types, NOT the csproj. The csproj ProjectReferences MediaBrowser.Common AND MediaBrowser.Controller, but the Controller reference is DEAD for the portable subset except for the two `static ConfigurationExtensions` string-key consts (which the charter says to inline). The AutoDiscoveryHost Controller/Hosting/ApiClient usings are all in the DEFERRED file.
real_cross_project_deps.MediaBrowser.Common.Net: REAL and central. NetworkManager uses INetworkManager (implements), NetworkConfiguration, NetworkConfigurationStore (StoreKey='network'), NetworkConfigurationExtensions.GetNetworkConfiguration, NetworkConstants, NetworkUtils, RemoteAccessPolicyResult. These live in MediaBrowser.Common but were DEFERRED by the hermit-common port (its 'Net.*' deferred entry) — so they must be ported HERE. Maps to hermit-networking (new modules). Ownership overlap with hermit-common to resolve at PORT.
real_cross_project_deps.MediaBrowser.Model.Net: REAL. IPData, PublishedServerUriOverride, ISocketFactory. Also live outside hermit-model's ported subset — port HERE (or into hermit-model and depend on it). IPData/PublishedServerUriOverride are pure value types; ISocketFactory is the deferred SocketFactory's trait.
real_cross_project_deps.MediaBrowser.Common.Configuration: REAL for the config-manager touch-point. NetworkManager reads config via IConfigurationManager (GetConfiguration<NetworkConfiguration>) and subscribes to NamedConfigurationUpdated / ConfigurationUpdateEventArgs. hermit-common ported ConfigurationStore/Factory/Validating/UpdateEventArgs but NOT the IConfigurationManager trait or GetConfiguration<T>. Port a thin ConfigurationManager trait (or a get_network_configuration hook) here or backfill hermit-common. Maps to hermit-common (extend) + hermit-networking.
real_cross_project_deps.MediaBrowser.Controller.Extensions.Confi: REAL but TINY — only the string-key consts AddressOverrideKey ('PublishedServerUrl') and DetectNetworkChangeKey ('DetectNetworkChange') are used by NetworkManager (via `using static`). Port these two consts INLINE per charter; DROP the other 13 FFmpeg/kestrel/sqlite keys and the IConfiguration.GetValue extension helpers (not referenced here).

real_cross_project_deps.MediaBrowser.Model.ApiClient (ServerDisc: DEFERRED — the JSON DTO AutoDiscoveryHost serializes over UDP. Port only if AutoDiscovery is un-deferred later.
real_cross_project_deps.Jellyfin.Extensions: REAL (small). NetworkUtils uses `LeftPart('/')` span extension. Maps to hermit-util (already ported) — verify LeftPart exists there or port the one-liner.
real_cross_project_deps.J2N.Collections.Generic.Extensions: 1x in NetworkManager (`AsReadOnly`-style). Trivial — Rust slices/Vec cover it; no dep.
real_cross_project_deps.Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http: DEFERRED — the `GetBindAddress(HttpRequest)` overload in NetworkManager + INetworkManager. Web-framework-specific; port only the IPAddress/string overloads (the tested ones). Drop the HttpRequest overload or gate behind an http-adapter feature.
real_cross_project_deps.Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration (ICon: REAL but thin — the startup config bag NetworkManager indexes with the two keys above (`_startupConfig[AddressOverrideKey]`, bool.TryParse of DetectNetworkChangeKey). Model as a &dyn getter / HashMap<String,String> / config crate. In tests it is a `Mock<IConfiguration>` returning nothing.
real_cross_project_deps.Microsoft.Extensions.Logging (ILogger): DEFERRED as a type; map log calls to `tracing`. NOTE: NetworkParseTests asserts specific WARNING message substrings ('IPv6 prefix-only', 'not-an-address', and NEVER-warns polarity cases) via a Mock<ILogger> — so the port must emit equivalent tracing warnings whose content the test can observe (or refactor those 3 tests to assert on a returned diagnostics list).
real_cross_project_deps.Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting (Background: DEFERRED — AutoDiscoveryHost's base class (IHostedService long-running loop). No port.
real_cross_project_deps.System.Net / System.Net.Sockets / System: std::net + external `ipnet` for IPNetwork; NetworkInterface.GetAllNetworkInterfaces (real interface enumeration in GetInterfacesCore) needs a host-networking crate (e.g. `if-addrs`/`network-interface`) OR stays behind MockNetworkSettings — the tests ONLY use the mock path, so live enumeration can be a thin, untested adapter (or deferred).

portable_types.name: NetworkUtils
portable_types.note: THE highest-value oracle target. Pure IP/subnet math: try_parse_to_subnet(s), try_parse_host (FQDN regex + IPv4/IPv6/[..]:port + '/' cidr), subnet_contains_address (IPv4-mapped-IPv6 unwrap), cidr_to_mask, mask_to_cidr, format_ip_string ([..] wrap + %scope strip), get_broadcast_address, is_ipv6_link_local (fe80::/10 word check). NEEDS `ipnet` (IpNet::contains / TryParse) + `fancy-regex`/`regex` for the FQDN GeneratedRegex. Directly tested by NetworkExtensionsTests (18) + NetworkParseTests IP-string/subnet cases (~28). LogInvalidSubnet emits the two asserted warning strings.

portable_types.name: NetworkConstants
portable_types.note: IPv4/IPv6 mask bytes (4/16), MinimumIPv4/6PrefixSize (32/128), and the RFC IPNetwork consts (IPv4Any 0.0.0.0/0, IPv6Any ::/0, RFC5735 loopback 127/8, RFC1918 A/B/C, RFC3927 link-local 169.254/16, RFC4291 loopback ::1/128 + site-local fe80::/10, RFC4193 unique-local fc00::/7). The /0 and IPNetwork literals become `LazyLock<IpNet>` or const parse. 32/128 are self-explanatory (full-mask) — the RFC prefixes are domain constants, keep as named consts (not user settings).

portable_types.name: IPData
portable_types.note: { address: IpAddr, subnet: IpNet, index: i32, supports_multicast: bool(=false), name: String }. Ctor defaults subnet to /32 or /128 from address family when None. AddressFamily getter has special IPAddress.None handling -> Unspecified. Value type used pervasively by NetworkManager + asserted in IgnoreVirtualInterfaces/GetInternalBindAddresses tests (via Address + Subnet.PrefixLength formatting).

portable_types.name: PublishedServerUriOverride
portable_types.note: { data: IPData, override_uri: String, is_internal_override: bool, is_external_override: bool }. Pure value type. Exercised by TestBindInterfaceOverrides via NetworkManager's override-matching path.

portable_types.name: RemoteAccessPolicyResult
portable_types.note: Allow | RejectDueToRemoteAccessDisabled | RejectDueToIPBlocklist | RejectDueToNotAllowlistedRemoteIP. Directly asserted by the 9 HasRemoteAccess_* cases in NetworkParseTests. Trivial C-like enum.

portable_types.name: NetworkConfiguration
portable_types.note: The settings DTO NetworkManager consumes. Portable subset actually READ by NetworkManager: EnableIPv4, EnableIPv6, EnableRemoteAccess, LocalNetworkSubnets[], LocalNetworkAddresses[], IgnoreVirtualInterfaces, VirtualInterfaceNames[]=['veth'], PublishedServerUriBySubnet[], RemoteIPFilter[], IsRemoteIPFilterBlacklist, AutoDiscovery. Also carries BaseUrl (with leading/trailing-slash normalization setter — worth porting the normalize logic), Http(s)Port defaults 8096/8920, cert path/pw, KnownProxies, EnablePublishedServerUriByRequest. BaseUrl normalization + the port/enable fields are candidate SETTINGS (see behavioral_constants). Deprecated EnableUPnP -> drop.

portable_types.name: NetworkConfigurationStore
portable_types.note: Only carries StoreKey='network' + ConfigurationType=typeof(NetworkConfiguration). ConfigurationUpdated compares evt.Key against this. Port StoreKey as a const; the ConfigurationStore shell already exists in hermit-common (type_key string). NetworkConfigurationExtensions.GetNetworkConfiguration = get_configuration('network') helper.

portable_types.name: NetworkManager
portable_types.note: The charter's First-Light target. Portable methods (all tested): get_bind_address(source: Option<IpAddr>/&str, skip_overrides) -> (String, Option<port>), is_in_local_network(IpAddr/&str), should_allow_server_access -> RemoteAccessPolicyResult, get_internal_bind_addresses, get_all_bind_interfaces, get_loopbacks, try_parse_interface, is_link_local_address, and the private matchers (matches_published_server_url / matches_bind_interface / matches_external_interface / check_if_lan_and_not_excluded). PORTABLE-WITH-CAVEATS: constructor's NetworkChange event subscription + Thread.Sleep(2000) debounce + Dispose are runtime — port the pure UpdateSettings/InitializeLan/InitializeRemote/InitializeOverrides/FilterBindSettings/EnforceBindSettings pipeline; skip the OS event wiring. MockNetworkSettings (static string parsed as '<ip>/<cidr>,<index>,<name>|...') is the test seam — model as a constructor param `interfaces: Option<Vec<IPData>>` rather than a global static. GetInterfacesCore (live NetworkInterface enumeration) is the only host-networking bit — thin adapter or defer; tests never hit it (they use the mock). Drop the HttpRequest GetBindAddress overload (deferred AspNetCore).

portable_types.name: startup_config_keys (inlined ConfigurationExtensions subset)
portable_types.note: INLINE only: ADDRESS_OVERRIDE_KEY = 'PublishedServerUrl', DETECT_NETWORK_CHANGE_KEY = 'DetectNetworkChange' (the two keys NetworkManager reads from startup IConfiguration). Per charter: do NOT pull the Wave-4 traits crate; do NOT port the other 13 keys or the GetValue<T> helpers.

deferred.name: AutoDiscoveryHost
deferred.reason: UDP broadcast discovery BackgroundService (IHostedService long-running ExecuteAsync loop on UdpClient port 7359, listens for 'who is JellyfinServer?', responds with ServerDiscoveryInfo JSON). Depends on Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting.BackgroundService, IServerApplicationHost (GetSmartApiUrl/SystemId/FriendlyName), and the Model.ApiClient ServerDiscoveryInfo DTO. Runtime UDP machinery + deferred app-host — DEFER per charter escape clause. Port later as a tokio UdpSocket task if server discovery is needed. Magic number: PortNumber=7359 (Jellyfin discovery port) — surface as a setting when un-deferred.

deferred.name: HappyEyeballs / HttpClientExtension
deferred.reason: RFC 8305 dual-stack connect race for HttpClient (SocketsHttpConnectionContext OnConnect callback: try IPv6, 200ms head-start, fall back to IPv4). Tied to System.Net.Http SocketsHttpHandler internals with no reqwest/hyper analogue surface (reqwest handles Happy Eyeballs itself). Only state UseIPv6 is set by NetworkManager.UpdateSettings — that assignment becomes a no-op or a reqwest client-builder flag. DEFER the connect logic; keep a UseIPv6 config flag if a custom client is ever wired. Magic number: 200ms IPv6 head-start delay — surface as a setting if ported.

deferred.name: SocketFactory (+ ISocketFactory)
deferred.reason: Creates a UDP broadcast Socket (EnableBroadcast + ReuseAddress + bind IPAddress.Any:port). System.Net.Sockets.Socket construction; the trait ISocketFactory is a one-method abstraction. Runtime socket machinery used by the (deferred) discovery/DLNA paths — DEFER. If ported, becomes a socket2::Socket helper. ArgumentException('localPort cannot be less than zero') is the only asserted-ish behavior but has no test in this project.

deferred.name: NetworkManager: NetworkChange event wiring + OnNetworkChange debounce + Dispose
deferred.reason: OS network-change event subscription (System.Net.NetworkInformation.NetworkChange.NetworkAddressChanged/AvailabilityChanged), the Thread.Sleep(2000) coalescing timer, the _eventfire race guard, and IDisposable teardown. Runtime/OS-eventing — not portable and untested. Port the deterministic UpdateSettings pipeline they call, not the event plumbing.

deferred.name: NetworkManager.GetInterfacesCore (live interface enumeration)
deferred.reason: NetworkInterface.GetAllNetworkInterfaces() host enumeration with loopback fallback. Host-networking; UNTESTED (all tests use the MockNetworkSettings seam). Provide a thin trait/adapter (or `if-addrs` crate) at PORT, or defer and require injected interfaces.

deferred.name: NetworkManager.GetBindAddress(HttpRequest)
deferred.reason: AspNetCore HttpRequest overload — Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http-specific, untested. Drop or gate behind an http-adapter feature; the IPAddress/string overloads carry all tested behavior.

xunit_oracle.fixtures: No JSON/binary fixtures. All data is inline [Theory]/[InlineData] + a few [Fact] + 2 FsCheck [Property] generators. Shared helpers: NetworkParseTests.GetMockConfig(NetworkConfiguration) builds a Mock<IConfigurationManager> whose GetConfiguration(any) returns the conf; NetworkManager.MockNetworkSettings static string seeds fake interfaces ('<ip>/<cidr>,<index>,<name>|...'). NullLogger<NetworkManager> + Mock<IConfiguration> startup. PORT NOTE: replace the Mock<IConfigurationManager> with an injected NetworkConfiguration (or a trait stub) and the static MockNetworkSettings with a constructor `interfaces` param.

files.detail: TryParse_ValidHostStrings_True (13 InlineData: ipv4, ipv4:port, localhost[:port], full ipv6, ipv6/56, [ipv6]:port, ipv6%scope forms, ipv4/mask, ipv4/24) -> NetworkUtils.TryParseHost(...,true,true)==true; TryParse_InvalidAddressString_False (5: 256.., trailing #/!, 9-group ipv6, [..:1231]) ==false; PLUS 2 FsCheck [Property] generators (TryParse_IPv4Address_True / TryParse_IPv6Address_True over random IPv4Address/IPv6Address). FsCheck has no direct rstest analogue — transliterate the 2 property tests to proptest/quickcheck OR a bounded loop of random addrs (needs a proptest dep, or drop to a representative sample). The 18 InlineData are the core oracle for TryParseHost.

InNetwork_True_Success (4: ipv4 /24 incl. negated-exclusion form '!x/32', ipv6 /56 incl. negated) -> nm.IsInLocalNetwork(ip)==true; InNetwork_False_Success (7: outside subnet, excluded ip, wrong-family, wrong /56, /120 exclusion, mixed v4/v6) ==false. Drives NetworkManager built from a mocked config with LocalNetworkSubnets. Oracle for is_in_local_network + LAN/excluded-subnet parsing (TryParseToSubnets negated pass).

IgnoreVirtualInterfaces [Theory] 6 (mock-interface strings -> GetInternalBindAddresses formatted '[a/p,b/p]'; exercises veth/vEthernet prefix filtering + IPv4/IPv6, overlapping interfaces); TryParseValidIPStringsTrue 11 (each also asserts '!'+addr with negated=true) -> TryParseToSubnet; TryParseInvalidIPStringsFalse 6; TryParseToSubnets_InvalidEntries_LogsWarnings 1 [Fact] (asserts WARNING contains 'IPv6 prefix-only' + the offending subnet, AND a generic warning contains 'not-an-address'; result has Single entry); TryParseToSubnets_PolarityMismatchIPv4_DoesNotWarn 1 [Fact] (2 non-'!' -> lan pass count 2; 1 '!' -> excluded pass count 1; NEVER warns); TryParseToSubnets_PolarityMismatchIPv6_DoesNotWarn 1 [Fact] (same for '::' CIDR); IPv4SubnetMaskMatchesValidIPAddress 7 + DoesNotMatch 6 (subnet.Contains); IPv6SubnetMaskMatches 5 + DoesNotMatch 5 (128-bit contains); TestBindInterfaces 8 (source ip/hostname -> nm.GetBindAddress -> eth16 internal / eth11 external selection; DNS-dependent cases self-skip when TryParseHost fails); TestBindInterfaceOverrides 8 (PublishedServerUriBySubnet 'subnet=uri' / 'all=' / 'external=' / 'internal=' / 'iface=' -> override or interface addr); HasRemoteAccess_GivenWhitelist 3 + GivenRemoteAccessDisabled 3 + GivenBlacklist 3 (-> ShouldAllowServerAccess == RemoteAccessPolicyResult.*). THE parity core: TryParseToSubnet(s) + GetBindAddress selection + ShouldAllowServerAccess. The 3 logging [Fact]s require the port to expose observable warnings (tracing capture or a returned diagnostics vec).

behavioral_constants_to_surface: AutoDiscoveryHost.PortNumber = 7359 (Jellyfin UDP discovery port) — surface as a setting IF/when AutoDiscovery is un-deferred.
HappyEyeballs 200ms IPv6 head-start delay (Task.Delay(200)) — surface as a setting IF/when HappyEyeballs is un-deferred.
NetworkConfiguration.DefaultHttpPort=8096 / DefaultHttpsPort=8920 — user-facing port defaults; already config fields, keep configurable (they ARE the settings).
NetworkConfiguration.VirtualInterfaceNames default ['veth'] — the virtual-interface prefix filter; keep configurable (drives IgnoreVirtualInterfaces).
NetworkConstants prefix sizes 32/128 (full masks) and IPv4/IPv6MaskBytes 4/16 are self-explanatory identity constants — keep as named consts, do NOT surface as settings.
NetworkConstants RFC subnet literals (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 169.254/16, fe80::/10, fc00::/7, ::1/128, 127/8) are RFC-defined domain constants — named consts, not settings.
NetworkManager LAN fallback (private + loopback subnets) is derived from those RFC consts — not a tunable.
needs_external_crate: ipnet (IpNet/Ipv4Net/Ipv6Net) — .NET System.Net.IPNetwork has NO std analogue; required for IPData.Subnet, NetworkConstants, TryParseToSubnet CIDR parse, subnet.Contains. NOT yet a workspace dependency — must be added to hermit/Cargo.toml.

regex OR fancy-regex (both already workspace deps) — for NetworkUtils FqdnGeneratedRegex (the RFC-ish FQDN validation regex in TryParseHost). The lookahead `(?!...)` groups likely need fancy-regex (regex crate lacks lookaround).
hex — NOT strictly needed here (no PHC/hex like hermit-common); byte<->address handled by std::net + ipnet. Omit unless GetBroadcastAddress port wants it.
if-addrs / network-interface (OPTIONAL) — only if GetInterfacesCore live enumeration is ported instead of deferred; untested, so can be a stubbed adapter.
socket2 (OPTIONAL, DEFERRED) — only if SocketFactory UDP broadcast socket is un-deferred.

proptest OR quickcheck (TEST-ONLY, OPTIONAL) — to transliterate the 2 FsCheck [Property] IPv4/IPv6 generators in NetworkExtensionsTests; otherwise replace with a representative InlineData sample. NOT yet a workspace dev-dep.
port_charter_notes: First-Light target = NetworkManager (bind/published-URL). Portable and the crate's reason to exist.
DEFER AutoDiscoveryHost + HappyEyeballs/HttpClientExtension + SocketFactory (runtime UDP/HTTP-socket machinery, heavy deps) per the task's escape clause.
Inline the 2 ConfigurationExtensions string keys (PublishedServerUrl, DetectNetworkChange); do NOT pull the Wave-4 traits crate.

OWNERSHIP OVERLAP to resolve at PORT: the MediaBrowser.Common.Net + Model.Net types (NetworkUtils/NetworkConstants/IPData/NetworkConfiguration/PublishedServerUriOverride/RemoteAccessPolicyResult/ISocketFactory) were DEFERRED by hermit-common's port and are NOT yet anywhere — land them in hermit-networking (recommended, self-contained) OR backfill hermit-common and depend on it.

hermit-common gap: no IConfigurationManager trait / GetConfiguration<T> was ported (only ConfigurationStore/Factory/Validating/UpdateEventArgs). NetworkManager needs a way to read a NetworkConfiguration — add a thin ConfigurationManager trait or a get_network_configuration hook; the tests inject config via a mock, so an injectable config source suffices.

TEST SEAMS to redesign (do NOT port the C# statics literally): (a) NetworkManager.MockNetworkSettings global -> constructor `interfaces: Option<Vec<IPData>>`; (b) Mock<IConfigurationManager> -> injected NetworkConfiguration/stub trait; (c) Mock<ILogger> warning assertions -> tracing capture or a returned diagnostics Vec.
3 NetworkParseTests [Fact]s assert exact WARNING substrings ('IPv6 prefix-only', 'not-an-address') and no-warn polarity behavior — the port must make those warnings observable.
